package.name: distance_based_rl
package.description: This package contains the necessary files to interact with the simulated ROS2 environment and train a reinforcement learning agent. The folder structure is organized as follows: - `distance_based_rl/agent/`: Contains agent implementation, training scripts and utilities for saving, loading, and evaluating the agent. - `distance_based_rl/env/`: Contains the ROS2 environment implementation, including the reward function based on distance to the goal, and the necessary ROS2 nodes for interaction.
